text: 9 teams per busy night pail grade window, one team didn't move at all. The two time defending champions are CB and honestly why would they? Two titles in a row 25 and 26.

But silence in the trade window doesn't mean the squad is perfect. So let's do a health check. But before that, if you are a true cricket fan, you must follow this page. Batting, loaded, face, sorted, pin, that's where it's kept worrying.

Their best winner, Kunal Pandya, turns 36 next season. He's brilliant, but every season from here is a bonus. Their last winner, Surya Sharma, fixed just 8 vkts in 25 and 9 vkts in 26. That's not a strike weapon, that's a holding pattern. And there is no plan B. If Kunal gets injured or lose rhythm, RCB walked in the middle overs with no worry to take vkts. On the dry pitches of Chennai and Lagnaud, that's the phase that decides the match. They didn't fix it in the trade window, so the auction is there last time.
Should RCP go all in for a wicked taking spinner or trust the squad that just want two titles? Tell me in the comments and follow for more.
